summary: Sonida Senior Living, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 13, 2026 reporting termination of its at-the-market issuance sales agreement with Mizuho Securities USA LLC, effective May 13, 2026, without penalty. The filing also voluntarily provides audited CHP financials and pro forma combined financials for a previously completed acquisition. This is a routine termination of an ATM facility and supplemental disclosure of historical financials, not a standalone special situation.
